THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCKADE.title: Rockade
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCKADE.descrip: At the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block for each Giant Rock played this combat.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_FORM.title: Rock Form
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_FORM.descr: At the start of each turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock} to your hand. Rock cards cost 1 less.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_ARMOR.desc: Whenever you play a Giant Rock, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_SLAM.title: Rock Slam
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_SLAM.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a Giant Rock to your discard pile. Exhaust.
